decisions.reason: Its dedicated web presence in both 2018 and 2019 and its close fit with the firm’s core formwork and factory-equipment business suggest results at or above aspiration levels, so management would retain it.

Because it was only briefly mentioned in 2018 and disappeared by 2019, this points to performance below aspiration or weak customer traction, so resources would be redirected to stronger automation projects or the established business.

Its continued mention across both years indicates at least satisfactory acceptance for a closely related accessory product, and the firm’s growth and technological breadth give enough slack to continue it.
A standalone page in 2018 followed by no website presence in 2019 is a strong sign that the product did not justify continued attention relative to aspirations, so it would be withdrawn.
The product maintained a page of its own in both 2018 and 2019, indicating persistent support and likely acceptable results within the firm’s established magnetic formwork line.

Its repeated mention in both years suggests the product remained useful in the portfolio, and for a medium-sized expanding German machinery firm such related niche components would typically be kept if they clear a modest aspiration threshold.
